headline: Argentine Farm Groups Clash Over Traceability for EU Anti-Deforestation Rules
summary: Leaders of the Argentine Rural Society and CRA traded criticism over a proposed traceability platform required to export agricultural commodities under EU deforestation rules.
why: Argentina is one of the world's leading exporters of soy and beef; compliance with EU deforestation regulations dictates access to European agricultural markets.

impacts.name: Soybeans
impacts.why: Disagreements over export traceability systems threaten Argentine agricultural access to EU markets.
